sanskrit: bhavantīśvarātmanāmaiśvarā jīvātmāno brahmavādino bhavanti sātrikāḥmārjayantyātmānameṣo'tramṛthaḥsamāpte satre yāvantaḥ sātrikā niṣedhāste'pratiṣiddhā bhavantiathotsavavidhiṃ vakṣyāmaḥprātarmadhyāhnasāyaṃniśītheṣuvāmī sarvamuktavattribhirmantrairarcayedityeva viśeṣaḥvāmānāṃ ca grahaṇamantrāḥpaśupāśasamucchedaṃ kāraṇaṃ bhairavoditamityādyasyagṛhṇāmi harṣajananīṃ bhojyasambhārasambhṛtāmiti dvitīyasyakāmapatnyarthapatnyanyatarāmpratyarcanamāvāhanavisarjane syātāṃ | netyeke satravatutsavānte ṛtvijaṃ dakṣiṇābhistoṣayetatha balidānavidhiṃ vakṣyāmaḥdvividhaṃ balidānamchedanamutsargaḥchedanaṃ rājñā samarthena vāśastreṇa vaghyā ghātanīyāstvaparādhinaḥapakarotītyete vadhyāstasmādbalau vadhyāḥtāpasā ityekehiṃsā dvividhāudyogahiṃsā prāsaṅgikī hiṃsā caprāṇinā viyogāya dehena karma kurute yatsādyātaditarā dvitīyāparānandaḥtaditarāyā devatāyā balidānādanyatra ca hiṃsanpāpamāpnoti

sanskrit: baliṃ prayacchanhiṃsrān śastreṇa hiṃsannānantyamaśnuta iti surānandaḥatha balidānavidhiṃ vakṣyāmaḥutkhananātdharmapālaśchedayogyaścesa evānyathānyo lauha āneyaśchedayogyanāsmādadhika iṣyate || 100tadardhāyatastadvaddīrgho dikkhaḍgaḥcandrahāsaścadvandvatvāvadhiricchā yajamānasya kārorvākramaśo vyākhyātā bhavantisaṃjñayā vyākhyāto bhavatītyekebalidānavidhiḥatha devatāpratiṣṭhāṃ vakṣyāmaḥvāstuhomena ca pracarantiatha devatāprasādasiddhaye'nuṣṭhānakramaṃ vakṣyāmaḥsaṃvatsaramayana ṛtu māsa pakṣa divā nakta vānutiṣṭhetprātardakṣī sāya vāmī vobhayoranyataramauttaraḥrudhira vā ājyenānavadānena dugdhena dadhnā voktavadvikalpa kālasyaya eva vidadhātyayana sa devatā paśyati sa devatā paśyatitathā bhūtvoktayatkāle pārānandaiśchedyānbalīn chedayetṛtu ya eva vidadhāti sa devatā paśyati sa devatā paśyatidadyādityunmattabhairavaḥtadviniyojayedityeṣa svagātrāsṛgbalividhiḥdevatānāmiti vahno ninayetdevatā visarjayitvā ca virametdevatā samabhyarcya puṣpairnāmnā sahasreṇa śatena daśabhirvārcayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00357 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: māsa ya eva0yasyā yadgandha tadgāyatryā tatpratīka tena gandhena vilimpet | śeṣamuktavatpakṣa ya eva0prāta smaraṇa tasyā yasyā upāsakā bhavanti | śeṣamuktavat | divā ya eva0aṅkana kavacāvṛttiścāgamoktasaṃkhyāyatanuṣṭhānotsargasnānamaḍāgānnāni ca prayacchetvāmānuṣṭhānānte kālikeyasya veśyābhyaścaivamyathāsaṃbhavamuktebhyo yathāsaṃbhava dānamvaiṣṇavānte vanasthebhyaścetyeketā hatvā sanyāsibhyo'nnavastre eṣo'vabhṛthaḥ sarveṣāmtathābhūtvoktavakāle snāna kuryātsaṃvatsara ya eva vidadhāti sa devatāṃ paśyati sa devatā paśyatiayana ya eva vidadhāti0tathābhūtvoktavat divyasahasranāmapāṭhamṛtuṃ ya evaṃ vidadhāti0purakāṇi bhavanti | tadgāyatryā sarvāṇi nivartayedityekesaptasvaṅgeṣu īṣadīṣadaṃśaṃ svayaṃ nirvartayedbrāhmaṇaiḥ śiṣṭamjaptena mantreṇa sarvāṇi yadīcchati tadā sarvāṇi svayameva irvartayettaddaśāṃśena tarpaṇamvā sarvāṇi japadaśāṃśena bhavantiabhiṣiñcāmīti mantramuktvādbhirabhiṣecanaṃ pratīkemantramuktvā mārjayāmīti mārjana pratīke kuśairdūrvābhirvādarvyāṅgulyā gandhaṃ mantramuktvā gandhenānulimpāmīti lepayetpratīkemantramuktvāpuṣpeṇārhayāmīti puṣpārpaṇaṃ pratīke
source_edition: Muktabodha M00357 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mantramuktvā svāheti juhuyātgandhapuṣpasragvastrairarcayetprapāvayantiekatve samanuprāpte tadā'vartanamithyata ityekehomatarpaṇamārjanabrāhmaṇabhojanamiti caturaṅgamiti digbhairavaḥhomādi tryaṅgamiti kālabhairavaḥmārjanatarpaṇābhyāṃ dvyaṅgamityākāśabhairavaḥprāṇāyāmān daśa vā tattadvayaḥsaṃvatsarasaṃkhyākānkuryātsaṃvatsaraṃ ya evaṃ vidadhati sa devatāṃ paśyati sa devatā paśyatidhyānaṃ kuryātayanaṃ ya evaṃ vidadhāti sa de0yathāgamaṃ dānāni dadyādbrāhmaṇebhyaḥṛtuṃ ya evaṃ vidadhāti0atha kālikāyāśca brūmo vāmataḥsmaśānavāsinīṃ tarpayāmīti jale sthaṇḍile vā kuśānāstīrya ninayetya evaṃ vidadhāti0svargadānisarvasiddhīśaḥ sampadyateyaḥ stotraiḥ stauti sa ghorāṇyenāsi taratisaundaryavānmadana iva bhavati apunarāvṛttiṃ ca sampadyatekuṇḍale'ṅgulīyakaṃ mālā vā evaṃ kṛtkhecaraḥ sampadyateca dakṣiṇā jalaṃ ca vastrayugaṃ yā upānadyugaṃ vā chatraṃ vātriḥ śrāvakācchrutvā khecaro'mitabaladārḍhyaparākramaḥ sampadyatejaptvā adarśana khecaro'mitagati sampadyateṣaḍeva camasā bhavati māteva kālikā tasya hitakāriṇī sampadyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00357 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: japanmuktakeśo nagna so'cirādyogīśvara sampadyatemantramuccārya tasminnagnau nikṣipetsa svairacara sampadyatehutvā sarvācārya sampadyatesahasra manu japatīha so'dīno'nte kālīdhāmagāmī sampadyateyasyāstā kālāṃ dhyāyati ya sa śiva sampadyatesaṃpadyanteyo niśīthe sahasra japati sa yuvatiśatavṛta sampadyateeteneśvarāṇāmanuṣṭhānāni vyākhyātāni vāmānitāni kālikeyānyevetyekepānavarjaṃ tāni dakṣiṇāni tasyā ityekedevatāprasādakāraṇa kimkāla ityekepradeśa ityaparetīrthamityanyearcanaṃ kecitsvādhyāyaṃ kecityatpadamānantīti śabdācca tadicchayetyekevṛṇute yasmādeṣaḥ svatantraḥ yathā jīvātmānaṃ īśvaraḥdevatāprasādalakṣaṇāni vakṣyāmaḥbhaktyā yaṃ na jānāti sa enaṃ vijānātītitānyudāhariṣyāmaḥ || 100veditavyaṃ mayi sa īśaḥ dīkṣito'bhavaditisamādhānamāmananti brahmavādinaḥatheśvarasākṣātkārakramaṃ vakṣyāmaḥudbhūtalakṣaṇo bhakta upatiṣṭhatyudaṅmukha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00357 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yathecchabhevamevamuktavadevāntardhānakramaḥparātmāna ca paśyatītyekeityunmattabhairavaḥ | tasmātprāyaścittakramaṃ vakṣyāmapunardīkṣāsakṛtkṛtājjātamanantaphaladaṃ tasmādvidvāṃstatsaṃcinuyātdvyahaṃ tryahaṃ vopavasetsampadyate iti prāyaścittamanābhisamadeśasthaṃ mahaccaturthamanyatyajamānaḥ śraddhayādṛṣṭe saṃbhavati tatpātranityekerājadaṇḍasya svīkāraḥ prāyaścittampurastātpaścāccaitānyanvitāni bhavantimuṇḍanādyācaraṇamiti paścādbhavatiiti prāyaścittakramo vyākhyātaḥatha vyākhyānakramaṃ vakṣyāmaḥupadīkṣottaradīkṣayorapyevamevaṃ nityanirvartananiyameṣumukhyaṃ tu yathoktamsvān gṛhān gatvaitadeva yathādhikāraṃ pracārayāmāsuḥmudrāmaithunāmakamityeke samāmanantite'pi pūrvavatvrajaturyathecchaṃ te'pi pūrvavatabhavaṃstato vāminastata auttarāste'pi pūrvavatvijñāyaiṣa māmapṛcchatsa bhavannikaṭamānīta ityenaṃ śādhītibabhūvatuḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00357 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jayaṃ cā'pa saḥpṛṣṭho nārado hovāca pārānandaṃ yajñavidhimavadhārayantvititānāpnuvanti naiśvarānlokānsamabhipadyante patanadharmāṇaupacārānyathā mando na te syuḥ sukhadāyina itihiṃsāyuktaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ na sukhaṃ dātumarhatisarvathā duḥkhadā paścāttasmāttaṃ parivarjayet* *?vatkurute sarvānyathāgnirdāruparvatānkuryustvavayavānāṃ vai te'pi hiṃsāviśāradāḥkuryātso'pi hiṃsādyaduḥkhabhāgititasmādaṣṭavidhāṃ hiṃsāṃ varjayedīśatopakṛtyatkāryaṃ yatsudhīḥ kuryāttatraivaṃ kalpayedvidhimsaṃśrapayettairyajetmāhiṣeṇa sarveṣāṃ paśūnāmiti kālabhairavaḥyadākāro likhitaḥ syātkṛtaḥ syādvā tajjātīyāyā ityākāśabhairavaḥsarveṣāṃ paśūnāṃ godhūmapiṣṭamraktacandanodakaṃ lākṣārasodakaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ rudhirāṇāmāmladravyayuktaṃ raktacandanodakaṃ rudhiramiti digbhairavaḥlākṣārasodakaṃ jambīranīramiśraṃ rudhiramiti kālabhairavaḥrudhiramityākāśabhairavaḥkevalaṃ jalaṃ rudhiramiti vasiṣṭhaḥyato vā etadicchettataḥ kiṃcittasminnikṣipet tena taṃ yajetkutracitpaiṣṭakānuṣṭhānaṃ pratīyansarvāṇi karmāṇi kurvītavasiṣṭhaḥvarhiṣainamālabhetvapoddharaṇādi samānam

sanskrit: samānaṃ pānagamanasaṃjñapanavarjammudgapiṣṭaṃ tṛṇādānāṃ prāṇināmgudhūmapiṣṭaṃ phalādānāmmāṣapiṣṭaṃ māṃsādānāmtilapiṣṭaṃ jalacarāṇāmodano bhūcarāṇāmcaṇakapiṣṭaṃ khecarāṇāmetadanyatamaṃ vā sarveṣāmgodhūmapiṣṭaṃ sarveṣāmbrahmavarcasvitvamāpuretābhiryo yajate so'śnuta ānantyamityupadiṣṭāste tathaivākurvaṃścāpaśyaṃśca sveṣṭā devatāmsa taiḥ pūjito nārado divamācakrāmajagāmākurvannevānyāndharmāndīkṣitaḥ śāktaḥjīvanmukto'bhavaccacāra devatāpārśvataḥ sa śāktaḥ kālikeyaḥmunyannenarpiṇāpārānandyā dīkṣayā śaibyā vidhūtapāpmā'bhavatmātaramiti nainasā lipto'bhavattaṃ śivaḥ pārānandaṃ kālikeyamakarotlipto'mavattataḥ sa pārānandyā dīkṣayā kālikeyyā vidhūtapāpmā'bhavatvaiṣṇavyā dīkṣayā vidhūtapāpmā'bhavatdīkṣayā soryā punarvidhūtapāpmā'bhavatyajedityāhurbrahmavādino brahmarṣayaḥ pārānandāḥtattadīyastattadevāsya tatsampadyatedadāti yajata upekṣate so'mṛtatvāya kalpate siddhāmīṣṭaḥ sa saṃtiṣṭhaterājñā ca yuddhamagnānāṃ yadā lābhastadā teṣāṃ hananampārānandī so'mṛtatvaṃ gacchati
